meta.decision_rationale: Decisions are recorded with the criterion applied and the expected effect, so that the Guardian can compare expected and observed effects at the review date.
tradeoffs: Recording expected effects slows routine decisions
Review dates add a quarterly workload
rejected_alternatives: Reviewing criteria only when a crisis occurs

decisions.criterion: Community voice: a collection decision the community cannot read is not a valid choice
decisions.observed_effect: Complaints fell from 9 to 3 in the quarter

decisions.decision: Introduce a fast-track acquisition lane capped at 10% of the budget
decisions.criterion: Equity of access: a service that favors those who ask loudest is not a valid choice
decisions.expected_effect: Urgent community requests served within two weeks without displacing curated breadth
decisions.observed_effect: Cap exceeded in May; requests concentrated on two titles
minority_positions: One member argued that the lane rewards the most vocal patrons

decisions.decision: Pilot a federated catalog with two peer libraries
decisions.criterion: Community voice: shared infrastructure must keep local curation decisions local
decisions.expected_effect: Wider access without loss of local collection choices
